scope: Static source and contract review for freezing the deterministic input/output identity of a later current-public-release complete three-arm calibration unit. No tests, dataset bytes, models, inference, scorer or GPU workload were executed by Web.

workflow_instruction_source.fallback: Followed the repository-pinned AGENTS.md, LOCAL_AGENT_RUNBOOK.md, WEB_HANDOFF.md, CURRENT.json, STEPWISE_PROGRESS.md and prior workflow checkpoints. Local execution still requires the complete installed research-autopilot harness.
workflow_instruction_source.effect: No workload was executed or approved outside the retained repository workflow.

reviewed_official_sources.finding: The public CLI accepts an image directory, defaults to non-fast/non-low-RAM bfloat16 and seed 44, selects actionmesh.yaml, saves per-frame meshes and deformation arrays, and optionally emits Blender/render diagnostics. The published ActionBench row requires explicit generation seed 42.
A directory of the released 00.png through 15.png files is loaded in natural order as RGBA with sequential float32 timesteps; at least 16 frames are required.
The public output required by ActionBench is mesh_00.glb through mesh_15.glb. The same run also saves deformations_vertices.npy and deformations_faces.npy after checking shared topology.
The non-fast public defaults are stage-0 100 steps, 40,000-face decimation, floaters threshold 0.02, stage-I 30 steps, guidance 7.5, anchor 0 and 16-frame temporal context.
The official dataset CLI consumes per-UID mesh_*.glb, uses scorer seed 44, 100,000 Chamfer samples and 10,000 ICP samples, and writes per-sample CSV plus summary.

review_findings.finding: The calibration UID is the first UID in the already retained canonical lexicographically sorted 128-object population: 000-000_03b69da8d2c94b5999bcf2605ee2ecd9. It is fixed before current-release generation or scoring and is not selected from an observed result.

The manifest pass requires successful immutable snapshot and full-population semantic admissions, rechecks the selected sample's 18 admitted files, rechecks the exact clean Git revision/tree, hashes the 13 required source files and carries the four model-snapshot manifest digests.

The later timing boundary is prospective and includes model load/generation, native plus two sigma-1 simple controls, all three official score rows, integrity collection, per-stage timing and peak-VRAM telemetry. Existing one-UID parity or adapter timing cannot price it.
Generation seed 42 and official scorer sampling seed 44 remain distinct.

OOM, unsupported bfloat16, model/dependency, preprocessing, export, control, scorer and timeout failures must be retained. The contract forbids automatic low-RAM, float16, fast, UID, seed, revision, frame, point or arm changes.

A successful CPU manifest is input/output binding only. A later successful one-UID complete unit prices that exact engineering unit only; neither is scorer qualification, the full-128 aggregate, candidate evidence or queue authorization.
